title: The Living Research Book

sourceEvidence.excerpt: datasets, code, models, computational environments, protocols, calibration records, design choices, rejected approaches, negative results, ethical restrictions, licences, and tacit knowledge. These materials are now scattered across supplementary files, repositories, private directories, and departing researchers' memories. The article fronts this fragmented archive without adequately preserving how its pieces depend on one another. The book exists to ask what publication should become when

hook: The paper is published, but the experiment’s real history is scattered across files and people’s memories.
readerPromise: Researchers, editors, and curious readers meet an alternative to rebuilding context with every publication. What should survive when a research team’s understanding changes?
protectedRevelations: Publication compiler design, governance implementation and detailed transition plan
visualPlan: Keep the article beside its wider laboratory dependencies, the connected research object, frozen editions beside a live branch, and the proposed pilot; remove detailed workflow demonstrations so the film invites investigation.
